summary_en: FY2027 interim dividend raised to ¥115 per share from ¥80, and full-year dividend forecast revised to ¥210 per share from ¥160, reflecting upward revisions to operating profit, ordinary profit, and net income attributable to parent company shareholders.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Furuno Electric raised its interim dividend for fiscal year ending February 28, 2027 to ¥115 per share from ¥80 announced on April 9, 2026, and revised its full-year dividend forecast to ¥210 per share from ¥160. The interim dividend increases by ¥35 per share, while the year-end dividend forecast increases by ¥15 per share to ¥95.

The revision reflects stronger-than-expected performance in the first half of fiscal 2027, with marine business sales outpacing initial forecasts despite anticipated headwinds from rising component prices. Consolidated earnings revisions for the full fiscal year show operating profit rising 23.5% to ¥21.0 billion from the prior forecast of ¥17.0 billion, ordinary profit up 29.4% to ¥22.0 billion, and net income attributable to parent company shareholders up 30.8% to ¥17.0 billion.

Under its medium-term management plan covering fiscal 2027 through 2029, the company targets stable implementation of a total shareholder return ratio of approximately 40%. The company determined the interim dividend increase after comprehensively considering mid-period results, full-year earnings projections, and financial conditions.
